newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cartel office seeks to decide on Bewag sale.
newsitem.headline: German cartel office seeks to decide on Bewag sale.

text.p: The German cartel office said on Friday it would ask European cartel authorities in Brussels to let it rule on the sale of Berlin power company Bewag to a group led by Southern Co of the U.S.
The cartel office sent its request first to German economics minister Guenter Rexrodt, who approved it and said he would pass it along to Brussels.
German utilities Veba and Viag are part of the group with Southern that has agreed to buy the Berlin government's 50.8 percent stake in Bewag for 2.95 billion marks ($1.7 billion).

The German cartel office, which has been successful in the past in winning jurisdiction from Brussels in merger cases, has said it is concerned that Veba's other activities in the Berlin region could give a market-dominating position.

Cartel office spokeswoman Elke Zeise said the German office is concerned about Veba subsidiary Preussen Elektra, which already has a presence in the Berlin area. ($ = 1.725 German Marks) 281303 GMT jun 97
